name: colony stimulating factor 3 receptor

function.text: CSF3R encodes granulocyte colony-stimulating factor receptor. Annotated molecular activities include cytokine receptor activity and signaling receptor activity. It participates in signal transduction and amelogenesis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to autosomal recessive severe congenital neutropenia due to CSF3R deficiency (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Chronic neutrophilic leukemia. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports sequence alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.

selection_reason: Panel membership with educational coverage; user authorized the complete proposed and reserve roster.

function.text: CSF3R encodes granulocyte colony-stimulating factor receptor. It participates in signal transduction and amelogenesis. Functional annotations also associate the protein with cytokine receptor activity and signaling receptor activity.
